jabs_head_height.definition: lead-hand punch, wrist within 0.4 T of the receiver's nose height at the peak

rear_head_height.definition: rear-hand punch, wrist within 0.4 T of the receiver's nose height at the peak

lead_body.definition: lead-hand punch, wrist at least 0.8 T below the receiver's nose at the peak (below his shoulders)

rear_body.definition: rear-hand punch, wrist at least 0.8 T below the receiver's nose at the peak (below his shoulders)

all_punches.definition: every arm extension of >= 0.35 T toward the other man (includes parries in the drills)

combinations.definition: consecutive punches by ONE thrower (sorted by peak) where the next punch's onset comes 0 to 1.0 s after the previous punch's peak; peak_to_onset_s and peak_to_peak_s at the file's frame rate; returned = the previous punch's wrist was back under half its rise (its back frame) by the next onset
